matches.notes: Highlights block includes pitchside interviews from 10:13.
Post-match interviews run 27:11-28:36 inside the highlights block.
Analysis is followed by programme trailers (46:53-47:29) before the next match.
Friday night fixture carried over as a full package and placed last; analysis runs to the end of the programme.

provenance.walkthrough:
00:21 studio opens the new season (Lineker/Shearer/Rooney). 00:53-01:14 setup for Hull City v Manchester United, handover to Guy Mowbray. Highlights 01:14-10:13 (Ajayi, Mendy), pitchside interviews 10:13-11:33, studio analysis 11:33-18:51 (Rooney and Shearer breaking down United's passivity), ending with the podcast gag.
18:51-19:03 studio links to Ipswich Town v Sunderland, Mark Scott at Portman Road. Highlights 19:03-27:11 (Emersonn, Angulo, Clarke late winner), interviews 27:11-28:36, studio analysis 28:36-32:54.
32:54-33:06 studio sets up Brentford v Tottenham Hotspur, Steve Bower commentating. Highlights 33:06-41:11 (Lewis-Potter, Janelt, Kayode; Thiago penalty miss), interviews 41:11-42:25, studio analysis 42:25-46:53, then programme trailers/promos 46:53-47:29.
47:29-47:41 studio links to Everton v Crystal Palace, commentator Steve Wilson. Highlights 47:41-54:20 (Dewsbury-Hall, Barry), interviews with Moyes and Sage 54:20-55:43, studio analysis 55:43-58:18.
58:18-58:31 studio sets up Nottingham Forest v Leeds United, Martin Fisher on commentary. Highlights 58:31-64:43 (Stach free kick late on), interviews 64:43-65:44, studio analysis 65:44-67:24 (closing with the Joe Hart trail).
67:24-67:35 studio introduces Friday night's opener, Arsenal v Coventry City, Jonathan Pearce commentating. Highlights 67:35-73:22 (Havertz, Tzolis, Odegaard), Lampard and Arteta interviews 73:22-74:27, studio analysis 74:27 through to the close of the programme at 79:13 with the table.
